title: Siblings, by element
caption:
Same parents, same house, same rules, and somehow four completely different people.

The Air sibling knows everyone's news first. The Fire sibling has assigned you the toast at the anniversary dinner. The Water sibling keeps the peace. The Earth sibling still remembers who broke the remote in 2012.

Tag your siblings and assign them an element. Then make them take the test to prove it.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
